generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contract value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs 7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tender will not be considered.
Tender application amount will not be refundable.
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The contractor has to complete the bid (quote the rates) for all schedule B items of the works mentioned.

The Contractor shall pay the Earnest Money Deposit EMD & Tender Transaction fee in the KPP portal using any of the following payment modes Credit Card, Direct Debit, OTC, National Electronic Fund Transfer NEFT along with online EMD & E bank guarantee, Insurance Surity bond.

The tenderer shall scan and upload all the original documents required for this bid to the KPP portal. The original documents shall be produced at the time of physical verification otherwise the tenders will be treated as Nonresponsive & liable for rejection.
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labour welfare fund.

Original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of the Tender process, and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. Necessary work experience certificate issued by the competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer, indicating the name / items of work executed, date of commencement, date of completion and the total cost of work executed shall be enclosed to the tender. Tenders without these details are liable for disqualification.
The tenderer shall have valid Class III and above Registration Certificate.
Omission and typographical errors which are in the opinion of the executive engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment
Royalty charges will be deducted from the contractors running bill as per the prevailing royalty rates at the time of payment.
The tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-4 and shall abide for the conditions contained in Standard tender Bid Document KW-4

Executive engineer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to award of contract, without there by incurring any liability to the affected tenderers or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected tenderer or tenderers of the grounds for the employers action
IT & GST will be deducted as per prevailing government order

Contractors have to upload the Certificates of works in hand of any Department/Institutions failing which the tender will not be considered. Action will be taken as per clause31 of SECTION 2: INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS (ITT) incase of incomplete/ false documents regarding works in hand for the calculation of tender capacity

The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer of equivalent shall be uploaded.

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and murrum etc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the work bill, then for such work bills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No.C1/115/MNM-2019 Dated: 30-06-2020 by Mines and Geology department
All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive incharge Engineer or equivalent
Annual turnover certificate along with Balance sheet certified/attested by Chartered Accountants should be uploaded with 18-Digits system generated unique number (UDIN Number)

Liquid assets and/ or availability of credit facilities from banks for meeting the fund requirement should be submitted in the prescribed format as per the state government circular No. GO-FD-CAM/16/2022 (P-2)/, Banglore Dtd 22-08-2022

The contractor shall quote the rates without adding GST for either materials or works contract (service). GST payable by the contractor under this works/contract will be paid to the contractor over and above the contractors bid amount.

The tenderer has to quote his rate by EXCLUDING GST. However contract will be concluded for the amount (Exclusive of GST) but applicable GST will be paid separately as per the GST prevailing at the time of execution. If the GST rates are revised during the contract period, the Tenderer / Employer has to accept the revised GST rates for making payment / recovery.
GST, MDP and other deductions will be done as per the prevailing government orders.
Only star rates are applicable for cement and steel given as per the prevailing GO No. PWD 159 CRM dt 30.09.2010

itemList.itemCode: Common SR 2023-24 Vol-4,Page No 134 Item No.2.5
itemList.description: Supply and fixing of FRP “C” section frame of size 100mm and wall thickness of 8mm (1mm) and Rib thickness of 12mm smooth finish with marine grade gel coat, with side projections at every 1 meter interval to hold the frame firmly in concrete including tie bar at top and key holes provided to tie the binding wire with reinforcement to maintain the alignment. FRP frames should be flushed to the top of the pier level after concreting to avoid damages of frames by debris of flood water. Binding of glass fibre mat must be Isoptholic polyester resin of marine grade with UV stabilizer to withstand all weather conditions and saline water (For any size). Anchor brackets to be provided to avoid the uplift of needles on either side of the groove, & all necessary works as directed and complete as per per specification. Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

itemList.itemCode: Common SR 2023-24 Vol-4,Page No 134 Item No.2.4d
itemList.description: Supplying and fixing FRP Needle gate made out of concealed GI tubes of suitable size & thickness. Zinc coating of not less than 360GSM, I.S make hot rolled from any reputed pipe manufacturing company. FRP wrapping all-round the pipe minimum thickness of 4mm and wall thickness of plates not less than 6mm. made out of Isoptholic polyester resin UV stabilized marine grade and fibre glass chopped strands of 450 GSM electrical grade with gel coat finish. The water seals to be made out of synthetic rubber (EPDM) and housed in anodized aluminium housing as per design and drawing issued according to site conditions with the warranty of 5 years for any manufacturing defects, & all necessary works as directed and complete as per per specification. For 2.20 to 4.00m width  & For 0 to 2.00 m Height Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.
